title: US Divorce Rate Fell From 4.7 To 2.4 Per Thousand
hook: US divorce is falling, not rising.
closing: The divorce decline coincided with later marriage, not proof that waiting caused it.
question: How old were your parents when married?

segments.say: The US divorce rate fell to 2.4 per thousand, nearly half its earlier level.
Women now first marry at 28.6, showing how marriage timing shifted alongside the divorce decline.
